AI influencers are getting way too realistic in 2026, but making one that actually stays consistent is still the hard part. The face is one thing. What sells it is everything around it. The same person from different angles, consistent locations, natural hand movement, imperfect phone footage and a voice that doesn’t immediately scream AI. I built this one inside Artlist starting with Nano Banana Pro. First, I made a clean character sheet so the face stays consistent across every shot. Then I created separate sheets for the locations and visual style, so the whole thing feels like it belongs in the same world. From there, everything goes into Seedance 2.5. The prompt does most of the heavy lifting: handheld phone camera, natural movement, realistic lighting, believable voice and all the little imperfections you’d expect from an actual person filming themselves. That’s the difference between generating a random AI person and building an AI influencer you can actually use across multiple videos.
